description:
A collection's top collection bid over time in ETH, one point a day
(at most 31, evenly spaced over a long period), as the Insights tab of
its GONDI page charts it: each day's top bid with fees and what
selling into it nets. Gives the first and latest days, the change
between them in percent, and the lowest daily top bid of the period
with its day. Each day is its last hourly sample, so a dip that
recovered within the day does not show. Answers "what's the lowest
daily top bid of X in the last 90 days?" and "how has the top bid of X
moved?". For the top bid now,
call get_collection_market. It takes a slug: when you have a name,
call search_gondi first and take the slug from its result.

collection_slug.description: The GONDI slug of the collection.
collection_slug.title: Collection Slug

name: get_top_bid_history

day.description: The UTC day; its values are the day's closing hourly sample.
day.title: Day

seller_net.description: What selling into the bid nets once its fees come off.
seller_net.title: Seller Net

top_bid.description: What the bidder offers, fees included, as the Insights panel charts it.
top_bid.title: Top Bid

outputSchema.description:
Daily top collection bids in ETH at each sample's own rate, the highest
across the collection and its wrappers. The top bid is sampled hourly and
a day keeps only its last sample, so a dip that recovered the same day does
not show. A day without a sample had no top bid recorded and has no point.

change_percent.description: From the start top bid to the end one; null without both.
change_percent.title: Change Percent

low.description: The lowest daily top bid of the period (each day's last hourly sample) with its day, the earliest when it repeats, read from every sampled day rather than the listed points.

points.description: Oldest first, one per day, thinned to at most 31 evenly spaced days that keep the latest.
points.title: Points

start.description: The first sampled day of the period; null without samples.

outputSchema.title: TopBidHistory

title: Top bid history
